name: Neptune's Restaurant
description: Ocean Park's premier sit-down dining destination, Neptune's Restaurant offers a generous buffet spread of Asian and international dishes with sweeping views over the Grand Aquarium area. A firm favourite for families wanting a proper break between attractions.

items.name: Buffet Adult
items.description: Full buffet with Cantonese, international and dessert stations

items.name: Buffet Child
items.description: Children's buffet with familiar favourites and dessert bar

items.name: Dim Sum Platter
items.description: Selection of steamed Cantonese dim sum

name: Ginger Grill
description: A relaxed grill restaurant near Thrill Mountain serving grilled meats, noodles and Asian fusion dishes in generous portions — a popular refuel stop for guests tackling the park's more intense rides.

items.name: Grilled Chicken Rice
items.description: Grilled chicken thigh with steamed rice and vegetables

items.name: Beef Noodles
items.description: Stir-fried beef noodles with seasonal greens

items.name: Iced Lemon Tea
items.description: Classic Hong Kong-style iced lemon tea

name: Tuxedos Restaurant
description: One of Ocean Park's most unique dining experiences — Tuxedos Restaurant lets guests enjoy their meal with direct views into the park's penguin habitat, combining genuinely good food with an unforgettable wildlife backdrop.

items.name: Penguin View Set Meal
items.description: Main course set with rice or noodles, includes drink

items.name: Seafood Pasta
items.description: Fresh seafood pasta in a light cream sauce

items.name: Kids Set Meal
items.description: Child-friendly set with a small main, side and juice

items.name: Hot Chocolate
items.description: Rich hot chocolate, popular in the cooler Polar Adventure zone
